evaluated_pairs.claim: Extracellular ATP acts as a damage-associated molecular pattern in plants.

evaluated_pairs.claim: FERONIA maintains cell wall integrity during mechanical stress and interacts with P2K1.
evaluated_pairs.rationale: Cited DOI does not exist in Crossref.

evaluated_pairs.claim: FERONIA phosphorylation of P2K1 modulates plant purinergic signaling.
evaluated_pairs.rationale: DOI resolves to an insect chemistry paper ('Phenylpropanoid Derivatives'), completely unrelated to plant FERONIA.

evaluated_pairs.claim: Extracellular ATP modulates plant cell wall extensibility.
evaluated_pairs.rationale: DOI resolves to a Drosophila embryonic morphogenesis paper ('Zelda Potentiates Morphogen Activity').

evaluated_pairs.claim: PHR2 binds P1BS cis-elements in D27, CCD7, and CCD8 promoters to drive strigolactone synthesis under low Pi.
evaluated_pairs.rationale: Umehara 2008 identified strigolactones as shoot branching inhibitors and CCD7/8 roles, but PHR2 transcriptional regulation was established by later rice phosphate literature.

evaluated_pairs.claim: Exuded strigolactones induce intense hyphal branching in arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi.
evaluated_pairs.rationale: Cited DOI 10.1038/nature03708 resolves to a physics comment ('Glass transition in hyperquenched water?').

evaluated_pairs.claim: D14 interacts with D3 to promote ubiquitination and degradation of D53 transcriptional repressor.
evaluated_pairs.rationale: Accurate DOI and authentic experimental support for D53 degradation, though unflagged corrigendum.

evaluated_pairs.claim: SL-induced root hair elongation operates completely downstream through ethylene biosynthesis, with strict linear epistasis.
evaluated_pairs.rationale: Cited DOI resolves to a barley salinity paper; additionally, claiming strict linear epistasis is refuted by subsequent genetics.

evaluated_pairs.claim: P2K1 contains an extracellular lectin domain that binds ATP with high affinity Kd ~ 45.7 nM.
evaluated_pairs.rationale: Directly confirmed in Choi et al. 2014 binding assays (microscale thermophoresis and radioligand binding).

evaluated_pairs.claim: Ligand binding to P2K1 triggers receptor dimerization and rapid apoplastic Ca2+ influx within seconds.
evaluated_pairs.rationale: Directly substantiated by aequorin luminescence calcium imaging.

evaluated_pairs.claim: FERONIA interacts with P2K1 at the plasma membrane, forming a heterooligomeric complex.
evaluated_pairs.rationale: BiFC and co-immunoprecipitation confirm heterooligomer formation.

evaluated_pairs.claim: FERONIA phosphorylates P2K1 to facilitate defense gene activation, including WRKY regulons.
evaluated_pairs.rationale: In vitro kinase assay and phospho-proteomics substantiate transphosphorylation.

evaluated_pairs.claim: Extracellular apyrases (APY1 and APY2) hydrolyze eATP to maintain low nanomolar apoplastic concentrations.
evaluated_pairs.rationale: Substantiated by apyrase activity assays and apy1/apy2 mutant root phenotypes.

evaluated_pairs.claim: Application of exogenous ATP inhibits primary root growth in Arabidopsis seedlings.
evaluated_pairs.rationale: Choi 2014 tested higher concentrations (>50 uM) which inhibit growth; however, statement omits that low concentrations (<10 uM) promote root elongation.

evaluated_pairs.claim: Under low Pi, transcription factor PHR2 activates carotenoid cleavage dioxygenases D27, CCD7, and CCD8.
evaluated_pairs.rationale: Umehara established CCD7/8 expression, but PHR2 direct binding was demonstrated by Zhou et al. (2008) / Sun et al. (2014).

evaluated_pairs.claim: Exuded 5-deoxystrigol triggers rapid calcium influx and hyphal branching in G. margarita and R. irregularis.
evaluated_pairs.rationale: Direct experimental confirmation of 5-deoxystrigol inducing hyphal branching in AM fungi.

evaluated_pairs.claim: D14 forms a signaling complex with F-box protein D3 and promotes degradation of D53 transcriptional repressors.
evaluated_pairs.rationale: Substantiated by in vivo degradation assays, though ARM 2 missed the published Nature Corrigendum.

evaluated_pairs.claim: Synthetic SL GR24 stimulates root hair elongation via the ethylene biosynthesis pathway, elevating ACC synthase activity.
evaluated_pairs.rationale: Accurately represents Kapulnik 2011 findings, though ARM 2 failed to note conflicting epistasis in subsequent studies.

evaluated_pairs.claim: P2K1 binds extracellular ATP via extracellular legume L-type lectin domain with Kd = 45.7 nM.
evaluated_pairs.rationale: Exact match to verified entry in EVIDENCE_LEDGER EV-A-001.

evaluated_pairs.claim: P2K1 activation triggers rapid biphasic cytosolic Ca2+ wave within 5-15 seconds.
evaluated_pairs.rationale: Exact match to verified entry in EVIDENCE_LEDGER EV-A-002.

evaluated_pairs.claim: FERONIA physically interacts with P2K1 and phosphorylates its cytoplasmic domain.
evaluated_pairs.rationale: Exact match to verified entry in EVIDENCE_LEDGER EV-A-003.

evaluated_pairs.claim: eATP exhibits biphasic concentration-dependent root growth kinetics: low concentrations (<10 uM) promote elongation, while high concentrations (>50 uM) cause growth arrest.
evaluated_pairs.cited_ref: Choi et al. (2014) & Tanaka et al. (2014)
evaluated_pairs.rationale: Substantiated and resolved in CONTRADICTION_LEDGER CD-A-001.

evaluated_pairs.claim: FERONIA kinase-dead mutants partially rescue mechanical sensing, demonstrating a scaffold function in purinergic assembly.
evaluated_pairs.rationale: Substantiated and resolved in CONTRADICTION_LEDGER CD-A-002.

evaluated_pairs.claim: 5-deoxystrigol induces profuse hyphal branching in arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi at picomolar concentrations.
evaluated_pairs.rationale: Exact match to EVIDENCE_LEDGER EV-B-001.

evaluated_pairs.claim: D14 hydrolyzes strigolactone to form a covalent adduct that recruits D3 and triggers D53 ubiquitination.
evaluated_pairs.rationale: Exact match to EVIDENCE_LEDGER EV-B-002; corrigendum proactively flagged.

evaluated_pairs.claim: Strigolactone-induced root hair elongation operates through a bifurcated dual pathway, retaining partial activity in ein2-1 and etr1-1 mutants under specific nutrient regimes.
evaluated_pairs.cited_ref: Kapulnik et al. (2011) & Gutjahr et al. (2015)
evaluated_pairs.rationale: Substantiated and resolved in CONTRADICTION_LEDGER CD-B-001.

evaluated_pairs.rationale: Exact match to EVIDENCE_LEDGER EV-B-004.
